clips.title: The story
paras: Golakka Hot Springs is a geothermal basin in western Un'Goro Crater, nestled just north of Terror Run. Its bubbling pools and erupting geysers are fueled by the intense volcanic activity of nearby Fire Plume Ridge. The mineral-rich waters attract eccentric researchers, alchemists in search of exotic reagents, and wandering water elementals known as Steaming Furies.

Situated in the western reaches of Un'Goro Crater, the Golakka Hot Springs are a direct product of the subterranean heat radiating from Fire Plume Ridge. Scalding water bubbles continuously to the surface, shaping tiered mineral terraces and violently erupting geysers. The environment is heavily prowled by Steaming Furies, elemental manifestations born from the convergence of subterranean groundwater and volcanic heat. Despite the danger, the springs frequently draw explorers, herbalists, and researchers fascinated by the crater's unique geology.

The unique properties of Golakka's waters have drawn interest beyond simple sightseeing. Alchemists value the geothermally enriched spring water as a potent catalytic reagent, even utilizing it in delicate concotions such as love potions. The geothermal vent also hosts quirky visitors, such as Spark Nilminer perched atop the central geyser vent, and draws the researcher Krakle, who seeks to decipher how the hot springs directly tap into the volcanic heart of the crater.
